cards.name: Pip in the Wild

effects.lua_implementation: The Fusion procedure requires the exact Pip code plus one Domestica Fairy and enables revive limit.

official_references.matched_structure: Elemental HERO Neos Knight uses an exact named material plus a race-filtered second Fusion material.

effects.printed_clause: Cannot be Summoned while you control a monster.
effects.lua_implementation: The uncopyable single effects now combine the conditional Special Summon prohibition with EFFECT_CANNOT_FLIP_SUMMON, whose condition checks for another controlled monster.

official_references.card_name: The Last Warrior from Another Planet
official_references.matched_structure: The Last Warrior from Another Planet demonstrates explicit summon prohibition.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the Fusion previously prohibited only Special Summons, so a face-down copy could be Flip Summoned while its controller had another monster.

effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase, while you control no other monster (Quick Effect), Tribute this card; send all monsters on the field to the GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A Main-Phase quick effect checks no other controlled monster, releases the handler as cost, then sends every able monster on both fields.

official_references.matched_structure: Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder uses a non-destruction mass send-to-GY operation.

effects.printed_clause: The previous effect is once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring provides the official HOPT key pattern.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to the GY: return this card to the Extra Deck; also add the named Pip from Deck to hand, then send it to GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A mandatory delayed EVENT_TO_GRAVE trigger independently returns the Fusion, then searches/confirms Pip and sends that same successfully added card.

official_references.matched_structure: Thunder Dragon Fusion supplies return-to-Deck/Extra handling.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed and fixed the missing Flip Summon prohibition.
